name: A-Skip
instructions: Drive one knee up to hip height while hopping slightly off the planted foot.
Strike the ground under your hips with a quick pawing motion, pumping the opposite arm.
Stay tall and rhythmic — this is a coordination drill, not a sprint.
longevityNotes: Cardiorespiratory fitness is one of the strongest known predictors of longevity. Short, regular conditioning sessions compound enormously over a lifetime.
overview: A beginner just your bodyweight conditioning drill for the quadriceps and glutes. A-Skip improves cardiovascular fitness and athletic coordination.
